When performing a code review, apply the checks in the prompts/review-code.prompt.md file.

When performing a code review, follow the review procedure in the instructions/pull-request-review.instructions.md file. Use the GitHub MCP server to read the pull request and its prior Copilot reviews before commenting.

This is a Go/MongoDB project with a small JavaScript management UI. There is no Solidity or TypeScript in this repository.
